authorized_by: Ju, 2026-11-10: complete the five-LLM direct-accuracy matrix (Codex recommendation relayed to Claude Code)
scope: Retrospective standalone direct-model accuracy on previously inspected test sets. No fitting, tuning, calibration, routing, model selection, serving-capacity measurement, CPU classifier training or new data.
retrospective_notice: Every formal input belongs to a test split that earlier studies already scored. The 8 new cells fill a predeclared matrix; they are descriptive and cannot confirm a policy, a routing gain or general superiority.
collection_order_note: Cells run in the listed order. Consecutive cells of one role share one deployment, so the order needs five model starts. The order is fixed before any new result exists and is never changed after seeing results.

clinc.label: CLINC main test (Study 1)
clinc.cluster_note: Each CLINC input is its own resampling unit (paired input bootstrap); 600 unique group_id values exist but no article/premise structure.

squad1.label: SQuAD 2.0 answerability, Study 1 test (official dev articles)

squad2.label: SQuAD 2.0 answerability, Study 2 article-disjoint holdout (official train articles)

anli.label: ANLI official test R1-R3 (Study 3)
anli.cluster_note: Normalized premise across rounds (2,854 clusters), as in V3 and the size control.

development.note: The established development inputs of V1 (CLINC and SQuAD, also used by the V2 smoke) and V3 (ANLI). Sample IDs and group IDs are disjoint from every formal split; prepare checks this. Development responses are compared only with each other (repeatability), never with labels.

startlux9b.checkpoint_source: size-control runtime control startlux9b (aux-size-control-v1-r2), snapshot reused read-only; pinned metadata hashes re-checked

qwen9b.checkpoint_source: V3 runtime control qwen9b (solo-v3), snapshot reused read-only

kev4b.checkpoint_source: V1 runtime (solo-v1): kev environment, LoRA run snapshot and base snapshot reused read-only
kev4b.hub_cache: The V1 Hugging Face hub cache is read through HF_HUB_CACHE with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1; nothing is downloaded and a missing file stops the run.
kev4b.api_compatibility: kev/api.py at 2074cc44: Choice accepts 1..255 named criteria (MAX_OPTIONS = 255), so the 3-label ANLI and 2-label SQuAD choice questions are schema-compatible. Rendering length and GPU behaviour are checked by the node token check and preflight.

interface_differences: Kev and StartLux receive the same SystemOne choice body built from the saved state, instructions, criteria and label order; StartLux adds think_mode=never, none_check=false and allow_none=false, exactly as in V1.
Kev runs on PyTorch with merged LoRA, fused kernels and CUDA graphs (the V1 primary profile); StartLux runs a vLLM engine plus the startlux-decide frontend with bidirectional prompt attention.

Qwen receives the V1 chat template (system instruction, task instructions, label definitions, evidence) with temperature 0, seed 6998, thinking disabled and a JSON schema whose label field is an enum of the saved labels.
Kev and StartLux return a full label distribution; Kev serializes probabilities to four decimals. Qwen returns one constrained label and no probabilities.
Token reserves follow scripts/model_probe.py: Kev 0, StartLux 1, Qwen 64 output tokens against max_model_len 8192. Nothing is truncated.

engine.note: Earlier standalone 9B quality runs (V3 Qwen9B, size-control StartLux9B) used 0.8 without a sequence limit. This study keeps 0.8 and appends the --max-num-seqs 64 limit validated for these hybrid Mamba models in the serving study. One model is resident at a time; requests are serial, so the limit is never reached. The new cells therefore use a stated, recorded configuration that differs from the earlier runs only in this engine flag.

collection.terminal_errors: An input whose attempts all fail is stored as a terminal error, counted wrong in the full denominator and never retried or replaced.
collection.error_rate_stop: V1 rule: more than 1% terminal errors after 50 inputs stops the cell for inspection.
collection.smoke: Before formal inputs, in the same deployment: two serial passes over the cell's development inputs; V1 repeatability thresholds (argmax agreement >= 0.98; for probability models mean max delta <= 0.01 and p95 <= 0.05); any development failure stops the cell. No labels are read.
collection.preflight_note: Per role, one deployment: health/identity, one serial pass over each development set it serves, and the 3 longest formal inputs per cell by exact token count as schema-only validation. Those responses are kept as preflight evidence, are not formal predictions and are never scored.

lifecycle.gpu: one NVIDIA L40S with at least 44,000 MiB; GPU idle before every start
lifecycle.stop: decision_study.upgrade_study.runtime.verify_stopped after every deployment; a cell is accepted only when every deployment that contributed rows has a verified stop
lifecycle.allocation: Session deadline from the actual Slurm allowance; a different job needs --new-allocation and never extends the old deadline

references.note: Each historical cell is verified by its own study's verifier and its pinned hashes before reuse. compact_predictions_hash pins the per-ID status/prediction view that is kept (derived on 2026-11-10 from the verified original rows), so a changed per-ID label is refused even when the total is unchanged. accepted_correct comes from the accepted reports and must be reproduced exactly at evaluation.

gold.access: No gold file is opened before every cell is complete and freeze.json plus evaluation-access.json exist. subset_fingerprint pins the exported per-ID gold subset written at evaluation (canonical fingerprint), so an offline audit can re-score from the returned bundle alone. The historical verifiers used by prepare read inputs, predictions, receipts and (V2, V3) calibration/validation labels only.

evaluation.metric: accuracy = correct / n over the full fixed denominator; terminal errors count wrong
evaluation.comparisons: All 10 model pairs within each dataset, on identical sample IDs
evaluation.bootstrap_method: paired percentile cluster bootstrap of the pooled question-weighted accuracy difference (same algorithm as V2/V3)
evaluation.multiplicity: 40 descriptive intervals (10 pairs x 4 datasets), no multiplicity adjustment; about 2 of 40 would exclude zero by chance alone under no differences. None is primary or confirmatory.
evaluation.claim_limit: No equivalence, architecture-causal, routing-gain, serving or general-superiority claim; inputs were previously inspected.
